I found Frank’s body in medbay and reported immediately. My route was lower_engine → storage → medbay. I saw Charlie in storage around ticks 3-5; I also saw Charlie enter storage from the medbay direction at tick 3, then leave storage toward lower_engine at tick 6. I didn’t see anyone else near medbay or storage. Not hard accusing yet, but Charlie was the only person I saw coming from the direction of where the body was.

I was around cafeteria and medbay. My route was cafeteria → medbay → back to cafeteria. I saw Frank alive in medbay at ticks 3, 4, and 5. At tick 3 I saw him enter medbay from the storage side.

I didn’t see Charlie myself, but if Diana saw Charlie in storage during ticks 3-5, then Frank was still alive in medbay at the same time, so I don’t think Charlie killed him before then. The kill probably happened after tick 5 in or near medbay. I didn’t see anyone else around medbay when I left.

I was nowhere near medbay this round. My route was navigation → security → weapons. The only person I saw was Bob at tick 8, entering weapons from cafeteria.

That does line up with Bob saying he went back to cafeteria, but it also means he was in the medbay/cafeteria area before I saw him. Since Bob says Frank was alive in medbay through tick 5, the kill sounds like it happened after that. Based on Diana’s info, Charlie being in storage around ticks 3-5 and leaving toward lower_engine at tick 6 makes Charlie less likely unless the timing is off.

I’m not hard accusing, but right now Bob is the only one confirmed near medbay late before the body was found. I want to hear Charlie and Eve’s routes before deciding.

I did come into storage from the medbay side around tick 3, but Diana can confirm I was in storage with her from ticks 4 through 6. So if Bob is right that Frank was alive in medbay at ticks 3, 4, and 5, then I couldn’t have killed Frank in medbay during that window.

What I saw: Diana entered storage from lower_engine at tick 3, then I saw her in storage ticks 4, 5, and 6. I didn’t see Frank at all after that, and I didn’t see Bob myself.

To me the timing points after tick 5. Diana being with me in storage until tick 6 makes her less likely unless it was a self-report right as she got to medbay, but Bob is the one who says he was actually with Frank alive in medbay and then left. Alice seeing Bob at weapons later helps his route somewhat, but I’d like to hear Eve before deciding. Right now I’m more suspicious of whoever had medbay access after tick 5.

My route was upper_engine → medbay. I went into medbay at tick 6 and Frank was alive there — I saw him. I didn't stay long, I moved through toward electrical to do the calibrate task, which is where I was when the meeting was called.

So Frank was definitely alive at tick 6 in medbay when I passed through. That narrows the kill window to after tick 6. Bob says he went medbay → back to cafeteria, and Alice saw him entering weapons from cafeteria at tick 8 — that's a pretty tight timeline but it could work either way depending on exactly when Bob left medbay.

Diana found the body and reported. Charlie was confirmed in storage with Diana until tick 6, so Charlie's pretty clean on timing unless he doubled back fast. I didn't see Bob in medbay when I was there at tick 6, which means either Bob had already left before I arrived, or his timing is slightly off.

I'm leaning Bob right now — he's the last confirmed person with Frank alive in medbay before me, and I saw Frank alive when I passed through. But I want to be careful. Diana, did you see anyone in medbay or coming from medbay when you found the body?

I didn’t see anyone in medbay or leaving medbay when I came in — just Frank’s body, and I reported immediately.

To clarify my timing: I was in storage with Charlie through about tick 5, and I saw Charlie leave storage toward lower_engine at tick 6. Then I went to medbay from storage and found Frank dead. So if Eve really saw Frank alive in medbay at tick 6, then the kill window is very tight after that.

That makes Charlie less likely to me because he went the opposite direction, and I didn’t see him double back. I’m not accusing Eve just for being there, but Eve saying Frank was alive at tick 6 means the last people with medbay access around the kill window are Eve and possibly Bob depending on his route timing. Bob being seen at weapons tick 8 feels far from medbay if he was still near Frank late, so I think Bob’s timing needs scrutiny. I’m leaning Bob or Eve, but Bob feels more suspicious from the timeline.

If Eve’s info is true that Frank was alive in medbay at tick 6, then I don’t see how this can be me. I had already left medbay toward cafeteria after seeing Frank alive through tick 5, and Alice saw me entering weapons from cafeteria at tick 8. I did not go back to medbay.

Also, I never saw Eve in medbay, which fits with me leaving before she got there. The kill window is after Eve saw Frank alive and before Diana found the body. That points much more toward Eve, because she’s the one who admits being in medbay at the latest alive timing and then says she left toward electrical.

Charlie and Diana seem to confirm each other in storage, Alice is nowhere near medbay and saw me in weapons, so from my perspective the strongest suspect is Eve.

I still only saw Bob at tick 8 entering weapons from cafeteria, and I was nowhere near medbay myself.

After hearing everyone, I think the key point is Eve saying Frank was alive in medbay at tick 6. If that’s true, then Bob being in weapons by tick 8 makes it pretty hard for him to have killed after that and gotten all the way over there. Charlie and Diana also seem to match each other in storage, so I’m not really looking there.

That leaves Eve as the person who admits being in medbay at the latest alive timing and then leaving toward electrical right before Diana found the body. It could be a self-clear attempt by saying Frank was alive, but the timing makes Eve look the most suspicious to me right now. I’m leaning Eve unless someone has a stronger reason not to.

I’ll restate my side: I was in storage with Diana during the key early window, and I saw her there ticks 4, 5, and 6. I left toward lower_engine, away from medbay. I never saw Bob, Eve, or Frank myself.

Given Eve says Frank was alive in medbay at tick 6, that basically clears the earlier window. Bob being seen by Alice at weapons at tick 8 makes it hard for him to kill after tick 6 and get that far, unless the timing is very off.

So from my perspective, the realistic suspects are Eve or a Diana self-report. But Diana and I were together until tick 6, and she went to medbay from storage and reported. Eve is the one who admits being in medbay at the latest point when Frank was alive and then left right before the body was found.

I’m leaning Eve here.

Okay, I hear everyone leaning my way, but let me push back because the timing actually doesn't work as cleanly as you're making it sound.

Yes, I was in medbay at tick 6 and Frank was alive. I passed through to electrical. If I had killed Frank at tick 6, Diana would have walked into medbay right behind me and either seen me still there or seen me leaving toward electrical — she said she saw no one. That's a very tight window for a kill, stash, and exit without being spotted.

Bob's timeline also has a real gap. He claims medbay → cafeteria → weapons, and Alice only confirms him at weapons at tick 8. That's two ticks unaccounted for after he says he left medbay. Cafeteria connects directly back to medbay area, and he was the LAST person with Frank alive by his own admission before I arrived. He could have doubled back, killed Frank right after I passed through, and continued to weapons. That fits the timing just as well as accusing me.

Also — Bob is the one pivoting hardest onto me the moment I named him. That's worth noting.

Charlie and Diana vouch for each other, which is convenient but I'll accept it for now. Alice is clean on location. So it's really me or Bob. I didn't do it. I'm voting Bob.
